H8289: plain, Sharon, the name of a place in Palestine
H7799: a lily (from its whiteness), as aflower of architectural ornament; also a (straight) trumpet (from the tubular shape)
H996: between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or
H2336: a thorn; by analogy, a ring forthe nose
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H1323: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively)
H8598: an apple (from its fragrance), i.e. the fruit or the tree (probably includ. others of the pome order, as the quince, the orange, etc.)
H6086: a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks)
H3293: a copse of bushes; hence, a forest; hence, honey in the comb (as hived in trees)
H1730: (figuratively) to love; by implication, a love-token, lover, friend; specifically an uncle
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H2441: properly, the palate or inside of the mouth; hence, the mouth itself (as the organ of speech, taste and kissing)
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H160: {affection (in a good or a bad sense)}
H5564: to prop (literally or figuratively); reflexively, to lean upon or take hold of (in a favorable or unfavorable sense)
H809: something closely pressed together, i.e. a cake of raisins or other comfits
H7502: to spread (a bed); by implication, to refresh
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H2470: properly, to be rubbed or worn; hence (figuratively) to be weak, sick, afflicted; or (causatively) to grieve, make sick; also to stroke (in flattering), entreat
H8040: properly, dark (as enveloped), i.e. the north; hence (by orientation), the left hand
H8478: the bottom (as depressed); only adverbially, below (often with prepositional prefix underneath), in lieu of, etc.
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H3225: the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south
H2263: to clasp (the hands or in embrace)
H7650: to seven oneself, i.e. swear (as if by repeating a declaration seven times)

H6643: splendor (as conspicuous); also a gazelle (as beautiful)
H176: desire (and so probably in Proverbs 31:4); hence (by way of alternative) or, also if
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)

H2088: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H7092: to draw together, i.e. close; by implication, to leap (by contracting the limbs); specifically, to die (from gathering up the feet)
H1819: to compare; by implication, to resemble, liken, consider
H5975: to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive)
H310: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)
H7688: to peep, i.e. glance sharply at
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H6692: to twinkle, i.e. glance; by analogy, to blossom (figuratively, flourish)
H2762: properly, a net, i.e. (by analogy) lattice

H6965: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H5674: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
H2498: properly, to slide by, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, pass on, spring up, pierce or change
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)

H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H6256: time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.

H2590: to spice; by implication, to embalm; also to ripen
H1612: a vine (as twining), especially the grape
H5563: a vine blossom; used also adverbially, abloom
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H3123: a dove (apparently from the warmth of their mating)
H5553: a craggy rock, literally or figuratively (a fortress)
H5643: a cover (in a good or a bad, a literal or a figurative sense)
H4095: properly, a step; by implication, a steep or inaccessible place
H4758: a view (the act of seeing); also an appearance (the thing seen), whether (real) a shape (especially if handsome, comeliness; often plural the looks), or (mental) a vision
H270: to seize (often with the accessory idea of holding in possession)
H6996: abbreviated, i.e. diminutive, literally (in quantity, size or number) or figuratively (in age or importance)

H5127: to flit, i.e. vanish away (subside, escape; causatively, chase, impel, deliver)
H5437: to revolve, surround, or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively
